narrative.intro: Southwest Valley Constructors recorded $2.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. All figures are contract obligations, except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables which are total contract values. Southwest Valley Constructors won 5 awards this fiscal year so far, with an average award size of $451M. Obligations shifted sharply compared with prior years: the company had $78.4M in FY21, then reported negatives in FY22, FY23, FY24, and FY25 before the FY26 increase. Department of Homeland Security accounted for the vast majority of FY2026 obligations with $2.2B. Department of Defense accounted for $11.8M. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounted for $2.2B of FY2026 obligations. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounted for $11.8M. Use these figures to assess concentration, program exposure, and nearest-term revenue implied by current award counts and sizes. Current-year totals are partial because they reflect fiscal year to date.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Southwest Valley Constructors' FY2026 obligations?
sections.body: Southwest Valley Constructors shows heavy concentration in FY2026 obligations, with Department of Homeland Security accounting for $2.2B of the $2.3B total. Southwest Valley Constructors recorded 5 awards in FY2026 to date, and the average award size is $451M, which underscores dependence on a small number of large awards. Department of Defense obligations stand at $11.8M, indicating a much smaller exposure outside the DHS business.

sections.heading: Which markets drive Southwest Valley Constructors' FY2026 revenue?
sections.body: Commercial and Institutional Building Construction drives the company’s FY2026 obligations with $2.2B. Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction contributes $11.8M. Those two NAICS markets together account for essentially all FY2026 obligations reported.

faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors has $2.3B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Southwest Valley Constructors recorded 5 awards this fiscal year and the average award size is $451M. Current-year totals are partial because they reflect fiscal year to date.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Southwest Valley Constructors?
faq.a: Department of Homeland Security buys most from Southwest Valley Constructors, obligating $2.2B in FY2026 to date. Department of Defense also buys from Southwest Valley Constructors, obligating $11.8M in FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Southwest Valley Constructors sell to the government?
faq.a: Southwest Valley Constructors sells projects in Commercial and Institutional Building Construction and in Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction. Commercial and Institutional Building Construction accounts for $2.2B of FY2026 obligations, and Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $11.8M.
